reason: At ₹99 for barely 100 grams, it will finish in two weekend trips, and I know packaged green chutneys rely on vinegar and preservatives that taste horrible.
objection: 100g is too small to justify the price, and packaged green chutney always has that synthetic chemical sourness.
would_change_my_mind: A certified preservative-free, clean-label formulation in a 250g bottle priced sensibly.
